title: 🔐 Mission 2 — Login Simulation
subtitle: Build a secure login check using if/else and logical operators.
instructions: Replace each ??? with the correct value so the login only grants access to the right username AND password.
starterCode:
# LOGIN SIMULATION - Morpheus Security Systems
# Mission 2: complete the code below

# Step 1: Collect user input
username = input("Username: ")
password = input("Password: ")

# Step 2: Check the login
# Replace each ??? with the correct value
if username == "???" and password == "???":
    print("Access granted")
else:
    print("Access denied")
hints: Check your workbook — what username and password should this login accept?
and means BOTH conditions must be true before access is granted.
Test it twice: once with the correct details, once with the wrong ones, to check both the if and the else run properly.

codeChecks.message: Set the correct username to check for.
Set the correct password to check for.

successMessage: Your login check is complete. Run it and test both a correct and an incorrect login to make sure else works too.
